text:
```yaml
name: Docs Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install -g vuepress@next

    - name: Create docs directory
      run: mkdir docs

    - name: Initialize VuePress
      run: npx vuepress@next init docs

    - name: Copy arc42 template structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p docs/architecture
        cp -r path/to/arc42-template/markdown/* docs/architecture/

    - name: Add navigation and sidebar
      run: |
        echo "nav:\n  - text: Introduction\n    link: /architecture/01-introduction-and-goals.md" >> docs/.vuepress/config.js
        echo "sidebar:\n  '/architecture':\n    - Introduction and Goals\n    - Constraints\n    - Context and Scope\n    - Solution Strategy\n    - Building Block View\n    - Runtime View\n    - Deployment View\n    - Cross-cutting Concepts\n    - Architecture Decisions\n    - Quality Requirements\n    - Risks and Technical Debt\n    - Glossary" >> docs/.vuepress/config.js

    - name: Add scripts for local development and build
      run: |
        echo "scripts:\n  docs:dev: vuepress dev docs\n  docs:build: vuepress build docs" >> package.json

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git add docs package.json
        git commit -m "Setup architecture documentation using arc42 and VuePress"
        git push origin main

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages (optional)
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs/.vuepress/dist
```
